name: sherlock
description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
one_liner: A free tool that takes a username and checks hundreds of websites to tell you everywhere that username has an account, useful for finding someone's online footprint.
buyer: A corporate trust-and-safety or brand-protection team that needs to find impersonator accounts or verify an applicant's online presence, within legitimate, consented use.
business_use_cases: A brand-protection agency runs it to find fake accounts impersonating a client's company or executives across social platforms.
An HR or background-check firm uses consented username lookups as one input in a broader, legally compliant pre-employment screening report.
A missing-persons or online-safety nonprofit uses it to help trace a person's last-known online activity across platforms during a search.

money_ideas.idea: Paid brand-impersonation monitoring service for companies and public figures
One-off consented background-check reports sold through a compliant screening business

steal_this: This is squarely a dev/OSINT tool, not a product on its own — be careful here. The only responsible weekend build is a brand-monitoring alert service for a consenting small-business client checking for impersonators of their own name, not general people-searching.
